description: The module split does not respect a meaningful purity boundary in practice: lib.py is presented as 'the pure core' that the effectful shell (run.sh/pm-paper.py) is supposed to call into (per lib.py's own docstring: 'the effectful shell ... reads the live book and calls these'), but no effectful file actually calls it (see FIND-001). This means the pure/effectful split described in the code's own comments does not exist at the wiring level — there are simply two unconnected pieces of code, one tested-but-inert, one executed-but-partially-untested (FIND-006/007). A purity boundary that nothing crosses is not a verified architecture, it is an aspiration documented in a docstring.

evidence.snippet: """pm-trade/lib.py — PURE decision math ... The effectful shell (run.sh / pm-paper.py / executor) reads the live book and calls these ..."""
